notes: the Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Rida appears only inside the story; his written reply («فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ») is a rescript from an Imam, so he is left out and the report is flagged (rule 11)
«أخيه علي» is read as the name alone (rule 7); the blessing after the first name is not part of the surface
